turnaround_reason: Capri got beaten down after the FTC blocked the Tapestry acquisition and Michael Kors/Jimmy Choo sales fell, but it sold Versace to Prada for $1.375B (closed Dec 2025), slashed net debt to ~$80M, and returned to profitability. The thesis is a two-brand refocus with Michael Kors at 'the beginning of an inflection.'
bullish_points: Versace sale closed Dec 2025 for $1.375B cash; proceeds used to cut debt to ~$80M net, transforming a stretched balance sheet
Two consecutive large earnings beats: Q1 FY27 (Aug) $0.67 vs $0.40 est (+66%), prior quarter +83%
Meaningful insider buying: net +633k shares over 6m, 30.6% buy vs 3.9% sell, incl. CEO John Idol
Cheap on forward P/E ~6.1; analyst mean target $22.53 vs $15.44 (~46% upside), rec 'buy' across 16 analysts
Mgmt guides FY27 revenue growth to return and EPS +40% as Michael Kors margins recover and Jimmy Choo turns profitable; Jimmy Choo has a path to $800M revenue
Strong near-term momentum: +9.5% over 5 days, +7.5% on the day of the dossier
bearish_points: Michael Kors turnaround is early and will 'take time' per CEO; accessible-luxury demand is soft and promotional
Dossier balance-sheet fields (D/E 973, P/B 12.7, total debt $1.39B) look stale/pre-Versace-close; the improved net-debt figure comes from mgmt commentary, so verify on next 10-Q before sizing up
Revenue still declining TTM (-3.5%); the top-line inflection is guided, not yet delivered
Consumer-cyclical discretionary spend is macro-sensitive; a US slowdown hits handbags first
catalyst: Q2 FY27 earnings and continued evidence of the Michael Kors comp inflection plus Jimmy Choo profitability turn
suggested_trade: Spot starter $15.00-15.50, add on a confirmed Michael Kors comp inflection at Q2; Jan 2027 $17-20 calls for a leveraged catalyst play given liquid options (ATM IV ~66%)
key_risk: Michael Kors comps stay negative into the holiday season and the guided FY27 top-line inflection slips, re-rating the stock back toward the $12.40 low
would_skip_if: Next 10-Q shows net debt materially worse than the ~$80M mgmt cited, or Michael Kors comps deteriorate further
